# orca proposal

Every `orca proposal` command. Ids: a full id, a unique prefix, or (projects) a name or path.

## `orca proposal show <group>`

the group's budget proposal: version, allocations, group limit, revision

- What it does: reads from the panel (no write).
- Who may: open over the socket (a flag marked human-only still needs a person token).
- `<group>`: a group id or a unique prefix

## `orca proposal set-budget <group> [--task <task>] [--allocation <allocation>] [--goal-review] --dimension <dimension> --value <value> [--proposed-group-limit <proposed-group-limit>]`

set one budget value: --task <t> --allocation work|handoff, or --goal-review; --dimension; --value <n>|none

- What it does: sends control verb `proposal-edit`.
- Who may: open over the socket (a flag marked human-only still needs a person token).
- `<group>`: a group id or a unique prefix
- `--task <task>`: a task's allocation
- `--allocation <allocation>`: work|handoff
- `--goal-review`: the goal review's allocation
- `--dimension <dimension>` (required): tokens|activeMs|attempts|sessions
- `--value <value>` (required): a non-negative integer, or none (a task's work tokens only: no ceiling)
- `--proposed-group-limit <proposed-group-limit>`: also propose the group limit (JSON) — human-only: needs a person token

```
orca proposal set-budget g1 --task t1 --allocation work --dimension tokens --value 800000
```

## `orca proposal set-agent <group> [--slot <slot>] [--task <task>] [--agent <agent>] [--model <model>] [--clear]`

set one agent selection layer (--slot worker|estimator|reconcile, or --task <t>); --clear removes it

- What it does: sends control verb `proposal-set-agent`.
- Who may: open over the socket (a flag marked human-only still needs a person token).
- `<group>`: a group id or a unique prefix
- `--slot <slot>`: worker|estimator|reconcile
- `--task <task>`: a task's own layer
- `--agent <agent>`: an installation id
- `--model <model>`: a model
- `--clear`: clear the panel's layer

## `orca proposal replace <group> --file <file>`

send a whole operation list {operations, proposedGroupLimit?} from a file; refused without --if-revision

- What it does: sends control verb `proposal-edit`; refused here without `--if-revision`.
- Who may: open over the socket (a flag marked human-only still needs a person token).
- `<group>`: a group id or a unique prefix
- `--file <file>` (required): the JSON document

```
orca proposal show g1 --json > p.json   # edit the operations
orca proposal replace g1 --file ops.json --if-revision 12
```

## `orca proposal edit <group>`

TTY only: edit the proposal in $EDITOR; the changed values are sent as replace --if-revision <the revision read>

- What it does: runs locally.
- Who may: open over the socket (a flag marked human-only still needs a person token).
- `<group>`: a group id or a unique prefix

```
orca proposal edit g1
```
